first-talking-to-him.player: Hello. What you are doing here?

first-talking-to-him.npc: Hello, I am a mountain guide for this historical expedition. I led the team to this summit.

first-talking-to-him.player: Would you be able to guide me up and down the mountain?

first-talking-to-him.npc: I don't see why not. I've not much to do while the historians are exploring.
I make many trips each day so whenever you'd like to travel, just speak to me here, at the Shayzien outpost, or south of the mountain.

standard-dialogue.npc: Of course. Where would you like to go?

steps.npc: Okay. Come back if you change your mind.
